summary: Two speech callers created SpeechSynthesisUtterance without voice/lang selection. On a Linux/Chromium system where the OS locale resolves to a German voice as the first entry, the browser used that voice for every speech event. Adding utterance.lang and utterance.voice = pickEnglishVoice() at every speak() call fixes it.

bugs_found.issue: new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(text) without voice/lang — uses browser default.
voices[voiceIndex] where voiceIndex=0 by default — picks the OS-determined first voice, which may be German.
No unified voice selector / preference store.
